_doc: The pairs the site shows, in order: the sample data in ../sample data/bundles/. Each entry names a bundle folder (bundle.json + figs/); short, scopes, paper and blog set display fields; accept_audit lets a bundle that fails the pipeline's audit be shown. upload: false hides "Compare your own pair"; with upload on, set pipeline_url to a running `skewcoder serve` to code what visitors submit.
